witnesses.name: proof_of_DataqueuePeak_which_implies_wit_2

Unpack dataqueue_ready: max_len>0, front/rear in [0,max_len), base<>0, slot length=max_len, and every entry in dataqueue_contents is Some. Prove dataqueue_count>0 from front<>rear and the two bounds: rear-front+max_len lies strictly between 0 and 2*max_len and is not max_len, so its modulo is nonzero. Thus seq 0 (Z.to_nat count) has a head; Forall on contents yields a Some e at its first entry. Normalize (front+0) mod max_len to front and choose that e, obtaining dataqueue_peak q=Some e. Unfold the nonzero-base branch of dataqueue_buffer. Split store_array at front using its bounds and length, identify the extracted nth entry with Some e, retain the missing-index array and the buffer pure conditions. Introduce the wand and merge the unchanged slot back at the same index to reconstruct dataqueue_buffer. All arithmetic and borrowing facts are to be proved inline; the similarly named nonempty/front and slot-view obligation definitions are not lemmas.
